messages:
Ravi K: quick heads-up — we're converting Maya Singh (contractor) to FT. Offer out, candidate accepted. Need an above-band exception (role L4, offer at 140k vs band top 125k) and day-1 benefits + relocation support. start date 2026-04-14. can we expedite?
Aisha (People Ops): thanks — can you drop the signed offer and comp rationale here? we'll need comp committee + finance signoff for >band.
Tom B: confirming — candidate accepted because of competing offers, relocation costs to UK included. happy to share market comps i used. :thumbsup:
Liam (Payroll): FYI — payroll cutover for international hire needs bank details and completed tax forms before first paycheck. what payroll effective date do you want?
Ravi K: target payroll effective = first day (2026-04-14). candidate requests benefits from day 1 due to prior coverage gap.
Aisha (People Ops): routing to comp-committee now. @approvals-bot please create approval ticket and tag finance + payroll + legal. attach market comp and offer PDF.
approvals-bot: approval request created: HR-5982. reviewers: comp-committee, Finance (Liam), Legal. ETA routing: 24h.
Tom B: pasting quick comps: ```Benchmark L4: median 115k, 90th pct 125k; offer 140k (includes 10k relocation sign-on + 5k transient housing).```
Aisha (People Ops): need formal relocation worksheet and candidate bank details for payroll. Ravi can you upload signed offer + relocation worksheet to https://hr.redwood/internal/HR-5982 ? also include candidate passport/visa docs for right-to-work check.
Ravi K: uploaded signed offer and relocation calc (files: Maya_Signed_Offer.pdf, Reloc_Worksheet_Maya.xlsx) to HR-5982. candidate passport copy in secure folder.
legal-bot: flagged — visa status looks like Skilled Worker pending. need copy of sponsorship plan and start contingency if visa delayed.
Aisha (People Ops): noted — please confirm: if visa delayed >30 days we fallback to remote contractor until clearance. we can still process payroll/benefits enrollment effective once right-to-work verified.
Tom B: candidate will expedite visa docs; they're onboard with contingency.
Liam (Payroll): once bank + tax docs are in secure folder we'll queue payroll setup. for UK hire we need NI and tax forms; if not received by 4/10 payroll will defer to next cycle.
Aisha (People Ops): cc Finance: @Liam (Payroll) — please confirm routing for the >band approval. we'll escalate to compensation chair if needed. :eyes:
approvals-bot: comp-committee lead assigned: Priya N. Current status: pending review (HR-5982).
Priya N (via approvals-bot): quick note — please include external market comp link and two manager justification bullets. I'll try to review today. :raised_hands:
Ravi K: added manager justification to HR-5982: (1) retention vs counteroffer risk; (2) immediate business impact on ML infra rollout.
Aisha (People Ops): perfect. once Priya signs off i'll route to Finance for budget hold and then finalize benefits enrollment date.
approvals-bot: update: Priya N approved compensation exception at 2026-03-21T15:12Z. forwarding to Finance.
Liam (Payroll): finance approved budget hold. payroll will process setup; candidate benefits enrollment date set to 2026-04-14 pending right-to-work.
Aisha (People Ops): all set — thanks everyone. moving to close the thread after HR-5982 completion. :white_check_mark:
